A PA- coated sorbent was fabricated by immersing MS11+75wt% TAPA in a bath of 1wt% TMC in solution while stirring for 1 min, then filtering the solid material out and drying it via vacuum for 1 h. The prepared sorbent was evaluated for its thermal stability in TGA, where it was exposed to 15% CO in N at 30oC for 30 min during periods of adsorption, then heated to 90oC in pure N 2 2 2 for 15 min to desorb the CO and regenerate the material. As shown in Figure 29a, this testing 2 revealed that the coated sorbent had perfect thermal stability with a capacity loss of 0.39%, within the margin of error. When the same sorbent was tested for its CO capacity in humid DAC 2 conditions, it captured 4.88 mmol/g as evaluated from the TPD curve from Figure 29b.
